tldr: Monday pre-open run: markets shut all weekend, so no new session since Sunday — every file re-verified and re-stamped to 3 Aug with honest carry-forward labels. The core risk to the book stays the RATE side, not the equity side: the 10Y sits at a one-year-high ~4.75% (2Y ~4.28%) and September stays HIKE-biased (feeds ~60-80%) after sticky +3.3% core PCE — the direct headwind for levered silver, SGX REITs and HK tech.

Metals came off their highs on a firmer USD (DXY ~99.8), not a thesis break: gold ~$4,054 (-1.5%), silver ~$57.7 (-2.2%) into the weekend — both near record/multi-year ground. Silver's larger drop is the higher-beta tell: keep favoring gold-heavy GDX over pure silver leverage and hedge the silver-vs-gold spread.
